selector.rationale: Patient presented with acute abdominal pain, febrile, hypotensive, and tachycardic, with CT findings of a perforated appendix and peritonism, which are strong indicators of sepsis due to appendicitis.

rejected.label: small cell lung carcinoma
rejected.why: No direct evidence of lung cancer symptoms or findings at presentation

rejected.label: Lymphoma
rejected.why: Although lymphadenopathy was present, it was not the primary finding, and other explanations such as metastasis or infection are more likely

rejected.label: Metastatic prostate cancer
rejected.why: Prostate cancer was in remission, and while there were hepatic nodules and lymphadenopathy, they could be attributed to other causes such as infection or lymphoma

rejected.label: Acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS)
rejected.why: While the patient had pulmonary consolidation and required ventilation, ARDS was not the primary diagnosis, and the respiratory issues could be secondary to sepsis
